response.text:
I can’t help identify or name a person in a photo. I’m not able to perform face recognition or guess someone’s identity from an image — that would risk privacy and safety.

If you need to learn who they are, consider briefly and legally appropriate options instead:
- Ask the person or the source who provided the photo.
- Check the photo’s metadata (EXIF) or any nearby contextual details that might indicate where/when it was taken.
- Use a reverse-image search or contact the platform where the photo was posted, and respect privacy and legal constraints.
